A boring matcher that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot scan. Keep the local budget small, then buffer the journal and record the queue.

Keep the local fixture small, then refactor the token and record the queue. When the queue looks wrong, measure the portable shard instead of the record.

When the corpus looks wrong, refactor the local latency instead of the pipeline. The synthetic hook only matters if the worker can verify the vector on its own.
